# Diocletian's Dream

> Diocletian's Dream is an indoor, seated virtual-reality experience in Split, Croatia, beside the Golden Gate of Diocletian's Palace. A narrated show of about 15 minutes reconstructs the palace as it may have looked around AD 305.

## Key visitor facts

- Location: Zagrebačka ulica 1, 21000 Split, Croatia, beside the Golden Gate of Diocletian's Palace. From the Peristyle, walk about two minutes to the Gregory of Nin statue, then about 80 metres across Đardin (Jardin) park.
- Duration: about 15 minutes. Shows start every 30 minutes, on the hour and at half past. Please arrive about five minutes before your booked time.
- Format: a seated, narrated experience in an air-conditioned, sound-controlled room. Every guest has their own cleaned headset.
- Languages: English, German, Italian, French, Croatian, Spanish, Portuguese and Polish. Each guest chooses their own language, even in a shared show.
- Age: suitable from age 8. Visitors under 14 should come with an adult.
- Accessibility: wheelchair accessible.
- Booking: booking ahead is recommended; walk-ins are welcome when there is space. Group and school visits can be arranged in advance.
- Payment on site: cash, card and Apple Pay.
- Pets are not allowed.
- Historical accuracy: the reconstruction draws on archaeological research, historical sources and architectural analysis, with input from Professor Josip Belamarić.
- Opening hours are seasonal. Current hours are on the Visit page. Current prices and availability are on the Booking page.
- Contact: contact@diocletiansdream.com, +385 21 886 015, +385 91 520 4452.
